# v1.0.0: Major Simplication & Core Feature Rollup

- Reduced file count for a leaner, zero-dependency package (6 added, 19 removed).
- Refactored to core Python standard library, removing external requirements.
- New concise folder structure: main.py, reader.py (mail routing/processing), pusher.py (push notifications), setup_cron.sh, README, and documentation.
- All previous multi-language health-report logic removed; skill now focuses on a universal IMAP mail processing pipeline.
- Features: provider-based routing, precise local timezone filtering, deep string normalization, keyword+body matching, regex structured extraction, and multi-platform push support.
- One-command cron registration for scheduled mail processing.
